description: This file defines interfaces for trace control and trace data within the WPEFramework project, including the ITraceControl and ITrace interfaces, along with a constant for buffer size.

classes.name: ITraceControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling trace functionality, including enabling/disabling and category/module retrieval.

classes.name: ITrace
classes.description: Interface representing trace data, providing access to category, module, data, and length.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Returns the category of the trace or trace control.

methods.name: Module
methods.description: Returns the module associated with the trace or trace control.

methods.name: Enabled (setter)
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the trace data.
